description: This Java source file is a Spring MVC Controller class named ProductController. It handles administrative operations related to products in an e-commerce platform, including creating, updating, duplicating, removing images, managing categories, and more. The class interacts with various services to perform CRUD operations and processes HTTP requests for product management.

classes.name: ProductController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller managing administrative product operations such as create, update, duplicate, image handling, and category association in an e-commerce application.

methods.name: displayProductEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the product edit page for a specific product by ID.

methods.name: displayProductCreate
methods.description: Handles GET requests to initialize the product creation page.

methods.name: displayProduct
methods.description: Private method to populate the model with product details for editing or creation.

methods.name: saveProduct
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update product details, including validation and image processing.

methods.name: duplicateProduct
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of an existing product, copying its details while ignoring references like SKU and images.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Deletes a product image based on its ID via an AJAX POST request.

methods.name: displayAddProductToCategories
methods.description: Displays the interface for adding a product to categories.

methods.name: pageProductCategories
methods.description: Returns a JSON response listing categories associated with a product for pagination.

methods.name: deleteProductFromCategory
methods.description: Removes a product from a specific category via AJAX POST.

methods.name: addProductToCategory
methods.description: Adds a product to a category and updates the interface.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set active menu items for the view.
